plays.story: D&D's Gen Con 2027 Vision Keynote drops a massive slate: seasonal roadmap (Champions/Survival/Sword & Sorcery/Rebellion), a Star Wars-themed Rebellion season, Universes Beyond crossovers, the WoW tie-in, and the new Icons line with classic creators.

angles.bizzal-games: Title: 'Star Wars in Your D&D Game: What the Universes Beyond Crossover Actually Means for Your Table' — break down the mechanical implications of IP crossovers (new classes/subsystems needed for Star Wars-flavored Rebellion season, how WoW crossover content will be statted, what third-party partnerships mean for homebrew compatibility).
angles.itsalreadywritten: Title: 'D&D Just Wrote Its Own Canon Five Years Out — Here's Every Story Locked In for 2027' — a season-by-season lore/narrative breakdown of Champions, Survival, Sword & Sorcery, and Rebellion, framing the roadmap as WotC pre-writing the multiverse's fate before a single table plays it.

plays.story: Vampire: The Masquerade is getting a new edition, part of a wider wave of new game editions announced around Gen Con.

angles.bizzal-games: Title: 'What's Actually Changing in Vampire: The Masquerade's New Edition (And What Storytellers Should Steal)' — a crunch-first look at rules revisions, clan balance, and mechanics worth poaching for other systems.
angles.itsalreadywritten: Title: 'Vampire: The Masquerade Proves Some Stories Don't Need a New Engine to Keep Being True' — narrative-focused piece on how the new edition handles decades of established Kindred lore and whether canon survives the rules reset.

plays.story: A critical flaw in Coldcard Mk3 hardware wallets enabled a 25-minute sweep draining $38M/594 BTC, prompting an official manufacturer warning.

angles.itsalreadypriced: Title: 'The Coldcard Mk3 Drain Just Repriced Hardware Wallet Trust — Here's What $38M in 25 Minutes Does to the Self-Custody Premium' — market/behavioral angle on what this does to hardware wallet demand, insurance costs, and BTC self-custody psychology.
angles.itsalreadywhen: Title: 'It Was Always a When, Not an If: Inside the 25-Minute Coldcard Mk3 Heist Timeline' — technical incident-response breakdown of the exploit chain, why Coinkite's warning came late, and what wallet firmware audits missed.

plays.story: Blockaid's H1 2026 report shows Ethereum and Solana led crypto hack losses, spotlighting where exploit patterns concentrate across chains.

angles.itsalreadypriced: Title: 'Ethereum and Solana Bled the Most in H1 2026 Hacks — What That Means for How You Price Chain Risk' — translate the loss data into a risk-adjusted view of ETH/SOL exposure for traders and treasuries.
angles.itsalreadywhen: Title: 'Blockaid's H1 2026 Numbers Confirm the Attack Patterns Security Teams Already Knew Were Coming' — dig into the specific exploit vectors (bridge, wallet-drainer, contract-approval scams) driving the ETH/SOL totals and what defenders should already be hardening against.
